types.name: EAGLAnim::FnAnim

fields.name: unk4
fields.comment: low: zeroed by every ctor (FnAnimMemoryMap ctor faa80, FnRunBlender 105000, FnTurnBlender 1042d0); PS2 +0 zeroed (FnRunBlender ctor 279328). Name invented

fields.name: type
fields.comment: medium: ctors store a per-class id as a dword (CompoundChannel 0xf, RunBlender 8, TurnBlender 9, DeltaQ 0x11, DeltaF3 0x14); PS2 +4 same values (279328: 8, 268bc8: 0x11). Callers deleting sub-anims read it as a word to index the per-type free list 0x

types.comment: Root of the EAGLAnim channel/blender hierarchy (PS2 sheet EAGLAnim::FnAnim: Eval, EvalSQT, EvalEvent, GetType, GetAttribute...). Xbox: vptr +0, fields +4/+8. PS2 (GCC): fields +0/+4, vptr +8, so derived fields from +0xc sit at the same offset on both builds. Vtable 0x1a0c6c (15 slots) is restored last by FnRunBlender/FnTurnBlender destructors.

types.name: EAGLAnim::FnAnimMemoryMap

fields.name: memoryMap
fields.comment: high: ctor faa80 zeroes +0xc; SetAnimMemoryMap (DeltaF3 100880, DeltaQ 103420) writes param to +0xc; GetTargetCheckSum f70f0 returns word map+2; InitSubChannels fb050 reads map+8 count; PS2 +0xc in SetAnimMemoryMap/GetLength. Intended type EAGLAnim::

types.comment: FnAnim + AnimMemoryMap pointer; base of FnCompoundChannel and FnDelta* (their ctors call faa80, their dtors tail-call faaa0).

types.name: EAGLAnim::FnCompoundChannel

fields.name: subChannels
fields.comment: high: InitSubChannels fb050 allocates map.count*4 and fills via 14210 per map key; Eval* call vtable slot +0x24 on each; dtor fab60 deletes each and frees the array; PS2 +0x10

fields.name: useFPS
fields.comment: high: UseFPS fafd0 stores its bool arg; EvalEvent fac70 scales times by fps when set; PS2 +0x14 (4-byte bool)

fields.name: fps
fields.comment: medium: EvalEvent fac70 multiplies times by (float)byte +0x15; UseFPS passes &this+0x15 to fab10 when unset; ctor zeroes. PS2 +0x18 byte (GetFPS)

types.comment: Holds one sub-channel FnAnim per map entry. Offsets equal to PS2 up to +0x10; Xbox bools pack (PS2 +0x14 bool4, +0x18 byte -> Xbox +0x14/+0x15); PS2 size 0x1c.

types.name: EAGLAnim::FnRunBlender

fields.name: animKeys
fields.comment: medium: PS2 SetAnims 2781c8 allocs count*4 and copies arg array into it; SetWeight 1051c0 passes entries to 14210 to create sub-anims; FastFree'd in dtor. GetAnims returns it. Name invented

fields.name: cycleInfo
fields.comment: medium: PS2 SetAnims fills from each anim's virtual (+0x70 slot) result; SetWeight reads [i]+6 word, +8 flags byte, +0xa/+0xb bytes to compute +0x38..+0x44; freed in dtor. Name invented

fields.name: velAnimKeys
fields.comment: medium: PS2 SetAnims optional 4th array (t1) copied here; SetWeight builds +0x20/+0x24 from it when non-null; freed in dtor. Name invented

fields.name: anim0
fields.comment: high: created by 14210 in SetWeight, deleted via vtable slot 0 + type free list in dtor; EvalSQT/BlendFacing use it; PS2 +0x18

fields.name: anim1
fields.comment: high: as anim0 (swap logic in SetWeight 1051c0)

fields.name: velAnim0
fields.comment: medium: SetWeight builds from velAnimKeys; BlendVel/EvalVel2D; deleted in dtor

fields.name: velAnim1
fields.comment: medium: as velAnim0

fields.name: weight
fields.comment: high: PS2 GetWeight 279300 returns +0x28; SetWeight stores weight - (int)weight

fields.name: numAnims
fields.comment: high: PS2 SetAnims stores count (a2); GetAnims returns it; SetWeight clamps idx to +0x2c-2; dtor releases shared buffer 0 when non-zero

fields.name: cycleIdx
fields.comment: high: ctor -100 (both builds); SetWeight compares/stores clamped idx

fields.name: skeleton
fields.comment: medium: PS2 SetAnims stores arg a1 (EAGLAnim::Skeleton *); passed to fa340 in EvalSQT/BlendFacing on both builds

fields.name: cycleLen0
fields.comment: medium: SetWeight: frame count from cycleInfo[i]; EvalSQT/EvalVel2D write. Name invented

fields.name: cycleLen1
fields.comment: medium: SetWeight: from cycleInfo[i+1]. Name invented

fields.name: cycleTime0
fields.comment: medium: SetWeight: (b+0xa + b+0xb)*const; divides frequency. Name invented

fields.name: cycleTime1
fields.comment: medium: as cycleTime0 for i+1. Name invented

fields.name: frequency
fields.comment: high: ctor 1.0 both builds; SetWeight computes (1-w)/t0 + w/t1; PS2 GetFrequency 279808 reads it

fields.name: phase
fields.comment: low: ctor 0; SetWeight rescales +0x50 using (+0x4c + +0x50)/freq. Name invented

fields.name: offset
fields.comment: medium: PS2 GetOffset 2792d0 returns +0x50; SetWeight rescales it

fields.name: alignedCycleIdx
fields.comment: medium: ctor -100 (both); AlignCycleBeginEnd reads/writes. Name invented

fields.name: alignQ
fields.comment: medium: AlignCycleBeginEnd takes &+0x58 and writes +0x58..+0x64; PS2 8-byte accesses and AlignVel read +0x58. Name invented

fields.name: aligned
fields.comment: medium: Xbox byte, PS2 word (+0x68); ctor 0; AlignCycleBeginEnd tests/sets. Name invented

fields.name: animSpeeds
fields.comment: medium: PS2 SetAnims allocs count*4 and stores sqrt(vx^2+vy^2) per velocity anim; freed in dtor. Name invented

types.comment: Cycles/blends N run animations by weight. Derives FnAnim directly (dtor 105050 restores 0x1a0c6c). All offsets equal to PS2 (ctor 279328 stores the same fields); only +0x68 bool differs in width.

types.name: EAGLAnim::FnTurnBlender

fields.name: animKeys
fields.comment: low: ctor 0; FastFree'd in dtor; PS2 SetWeight uses. Name invented

fields.name: beginBlender
fields.comment: medium: passed as this to FnRunBlender::ComputeBeginRootQ/ComputeEndRootQ on both builds (BlendBeginFacing, BlendVel, EvalSQT). Name invented

fields.name: endBlender
fields.comment: medium: as +0x10. Name invented

fields.name: weight
fields.comment: high: PS2 GetWeight 27a9b0 returns +0x18

fields.name: numAnims
fields.comment: medium: dtor releases shared buffer 1 when non-zero (cf FnRunBlender +0x2c); PS2 SetWeight

fields.name: cycleIdx
fields.comment: medium: ctor -100 both builds

fields.name: skeleton
fields.comment: medium: passed to fa340 in EvalSQT (PS2 262aa8), same as FnRunBlender +0x34

fields.name: cycleLen0
fields.comment: low: written by EvalSQT/EvalVel2D, PS2 SetWeight. Name invented

fields.name: cycleLen1
fields.comment: low: as +0x28. Name invented

fields.name: cycleTime0
fields.comment: low: as +0x28. Name invented

fields.name: cycleTime1
fields.comment: low: as +0x28. Name invented

fields.name: frequency
fields.comment: medium: ctor 1.0 both builds (cf FnRunBlender +0x48)

fields.name: phase
fields.comment: low: ctor 0 (cf FnRunBlender +0x4c). Name invented

fields.name: offset
fields.comment: low: ctor 0 (cf FnRunBlender +0x50). Name invented

fields.name: alignedCycleIdx
fields.comment: medium: ctor -100; AlignCycleBeginEnd. Name invented

fields.name: alignQ
fields.comment: medium: AlignCycleBeginEnd takes &+0x48 and writes floats up to +0x54; PS2 8-byte accesses, AlignVel. Name invented

fields.name: aligned
fields.comment: medium: Xbox byte / PS2 word +0x58; ctor 0; AlignCycleBeginEnd. Name invented

types.comment: Turn blender; derives FnAnim directly (dtor 104310 restores 0x1a0c6c). Offsets equal on both builds; only +0x58 bool width differs.

types.name: EAGLAnim::FnDeltaF3

fields.name: prevKeyIdx
fields.comment: medium: ctor ff280 sets -1; SetAnimMemoryMap resets to -1 (DeltaF3 100880); EvalSQTMask writes; PS2 +0x10. Name invented

fields.name: bufferA
fields.comment: medium: InitBuffersAsRequired allocs count*16 into +0x14 and +0x18 (DeltaF3 ffd20); dtor frees +0x14. Name invented

fields.name: curA
fields.comment: medium: same allocation as +0x14; EvalSQT reads; dtor gate. Name invented

fields.name: nextKeyIdx
fields.comment: medium: ctor -1; SetAnimMemoryMap resets to -1. Name invented

fields.name: bufferB
fields.comment: medium: InitBuffersAsRequired count*16 into +0x20/+0x24; dtor frees. Name invented

fields.name: curB
fields.comment: medium: same allocation as +0x20. Name invented

fields.name: unk28
fields.comment: low: read by EvalSQTMask only (PS2 EvalSQT/EvalSQTMask). Name invented

fields.name: dequantParams
fields.comment: medium: InitBuffersAsRequired allocs count*48 and fills 12 floats per entry from map data; dtor frees. Name invented

types.comment: Delta-compressed float channel. Offsets equal to PS2 (all dword fields). InitBuffersAsRequired allocates the buffers lazily; dtor frees +0x14/+0x20/+0x2c when +0x18 set, then ~FnAnimMemoryMap (faaa0).
